name: Rankou!! Yarimakuri ☆ Online ~Hajimeyou, Ecchi de Bitch na Kasou Genjitsu~
original_name: 乱交!!ヤリマクリ☆オンライン ～はじめよう、エッチでビッチな仮想現実～
source:
Tomoko Hazakura is usually a serious, quiet girl who does not stand out in class. But in fact, she is a very sexually curious and mousy girl.

She even thinks, “Oh, I don't care who it's with, I want to have sex with them", but as expected, that's not going to happen. She is afraid of catching something.

No matter how much she wanted to have sex, she couldn't take the plunge. One day, however, she hears a rumor. She heard that there is a VRMMO where you can be raped by other players out of the blue.

This information is considered a rumor, but Tomoko can't help but confirm it. Because if the rumor is true, it doesn't matter what they do to her. That's exactly what she longs for, even Nakadashi sex.

Thus, Tomoko creates a character with a high level of exposure so that she can be easily raped, and begins to play the rumored VRMMO. She wants to have sex all the time, that's her only goal.

translation:
叶樱朋子平时是个严肃安静、在班上毫不起眼的女孩。但实际上，她是个性好奇心旺盛、胆小怯懦的女孩。

她甚至会想：“我不在乎对象是谁，我想和人做爱。”但这种事当然不会发生，因为她害怕染上疾病。

无论多么渴望性爱，她都不敢迈出那一步。然而某天，她听到一个传闻：有一款VRMMO，玩家可能会突然被其他玩家强奸。

这被认为只是传闻，但朋子无法不去确认。因为如果传闻是真的，无论对方对她做什么都无所谓。这正是她渴望的事情，甚至包括中出。

于是，朋子创建了一个暴露度很高、容易被强奸的角色，开始游玩那款传闻中的VRMMO。她唯一的目标，就是不停地做爱。
